svg.title: Allocate a $40,000 Reference Startup Budget Across Four Buckets
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-forty-thousand-startup-capital-buckets; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $40,000 Reference Startup Budget Across Four Buckets; subtitle: Compare lean $12,000, reference $40,000, and expanded $75,000 plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are USD allocations for the illustrative $40,000 reference plan within the $12,000–$75,000 startup capital range, not annual expenses or canonical revenue. The same 35% / 25% / 20% / 20% split produces the lean $12,000 and expanded $75,000 comparisons stated in the details. Startup capital does not establish runway: recurring monthly opex is $2,000–$12,000 and first-deal timing is 4–14 months.; caption: Reference: $14,000 + $10,000 + $8,000 + $8,000 = $40,000. Lean: $4,200 + $3,000 + $2,400 + $2,400 = $12,000. Expanded: $26,250 + $18,750 + $15,000 + $15,000 = $75,000. The reference liquidity bucket covers 0.8 months at $10,000 recurring monthly opex, so separately fund the remaining development period and variable costs.; stages: label: Rights diligence and contracting; value: $14,000 reference plan allocation for defensible grants; numeric value: 14000.0; detail: Allocate 35% to title investigation, asset schedules, and contract drafting: $4,200 in the lean $12,000 plan, $14,000 in the reference $40,000 plan, and $26,250 in the expanded $75,000 plan.; label: Buyer validation and packaging; value: $10,000 reference plan allocation for commercial evidence; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Allocate 25% to technical demonstrations, buyer interviews, and scoped licensing materials: $3,000 in the lean $12,000 plan, $10,000 in the reference $40,000 plan, and $18,750 in the expanded $75,000 plan.; label: Reporting and obligation systems; value: $8,000 reference plan allocation for inspectable operations; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Allocate 20% to report templates, controlled document storage, SQLite reconciliation, and renewal scheduling: $2,400 in the lean $12,000 plan, $8,000 in the reference $40,000 plan, and $15,000 in the expanded $75,000 plan.; label: Uncommitted operating liquidity; value: $8,000 reference plan allocation for cash continuity; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Hold 20% as cash rather than recording an immediate expense: $2,400 in the lean $12,000 plan, $8,000 in the reference $40,000 plan, and $15,000 in the expanded $75,000 plan. Do not treat this reserve as acquisition funding twice.
